name: Menage a Trois
source:
Sol Fitzroy is a gloomy girl starting college at her parent’s behest. She expects nothing from the prestigious Ivy University, but with soccer sweetheart Chet Chester and football star Bill Lowman, Sol might have a good time in the end.

As Chet encounters hostile teammates and Bill deals with his father’s expectations, Sol makes a realization of her own. Menage a Trois is a trans visual novel with an established relationship, an all-American football star, and many cute scenes.

[From [url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/menage-a-trois]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Sol Fitzroy是个阴郁的女孩，在父母的要求下开始了大学生活。她对名校Ivy University不抱任何期待，但有了足球队的甜心Chet Chester和橄榄球明星Bill Lowman，她最终也许会度过一段美好的时光。

Chet遭遇怀有敌意的队友，Bill则要应对父亲的期望，而Sol也逐渐有所领悟。《Menage a Trois》是一部跨性别题材视觉小说，讲述一段已经确立的恋爱关系、一位典型的美国橄榄球明星，还有许多可爱的片段。

[摘自[url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/menage-a-trois]Itch.io[/url]]
